comment: Goal 1 refers to a single high-quality data capture supporting clinical care, facility management, population analytics, public health monitoring 'and domestic AI development simultaneously'. Throughout Chapters 1 and 2, AI appears only as a consumer of data. The reciprocal question — where the resulting AI capability is executed, and under whose control — is not posed, although Chapter 5 may address it (not reviewed here). If the ambition is domestic AI development, then domestic AI operation is the corresponding architectural requirement, and the two should be stated together.
